agent: Added `boss_explosion`: the explosion preset stretched to 2.4 s, a lower thump and an echoing second blast. It's in a new `boss` loudness category (-11 LUFS in segan.toml) so it's louder than every other SFX on purpose; the normal explosion stays at -14.
ran: segan new sfx boss_explosion --preset explosion --description "The boss blows up..."
